Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class StaffDetailsPopupController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.StaffDetailsPopupController
public class StaffDetailsPopupController extends Object
Controller for the Staff Details popup window in the Cafe94 system.

This popup allows the manager to add a new staff member or edit details of an existing one. Fields include name, role, password, and working hours.

The controller also allows launching a separate popup to manage weekly working hours and ensures input validation before saving.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(Staff staff, boolean isNew)
      Sets up the popup view with an existing or new staff member's details. Fields are pre-filled for editing, or initialized for adding.
      Parameters:
      staff - The staff member being added or edited.
      isNew - true if adding a new staff member; false if editing.

    • isSaved

      public boolean isSaved()
      Returns whether the staff details were successfully saved.
      Returns:
      true if saved; false otherwise

    • handleCancel

      private void handleCancel()
      Handles the Cancel button action. Closes the current popup window without saving any changes.

    • handleSave

      private void handleSave()
      Handles the Save button action. Validates user input, updates the staff object, saves the data to file, and closes the popup if input is valid.

      Displays alerts if the input is incomplete or incorrectly formatted.

    • handleEditWorkingHours

      private void handleEditWorkingHours()
      Handles the Edit Working Hours button action. Opens the working hours popup to allow detailed editing of daily hours. Updates the total "hours to work" in the main form if changes are saved.
